title: Uni Days
blurb: All-nighters, group projects, cheap noodles and the lecture you slept through.

questions.text: Who would be most likely to start an essay at 11pm the night before and still get a distinction?
Who is most likely to sleep through an exam and turn up for the end of it?
Who would be most likely to be the one who did all the work in a group project?
Who would survive on instant noodles for an entire semester?
Who among us is most likely to sit in the front row of every lecture?
Who would be most likely to sit at the back and watch a whole series on a laptop?
Who do you reckon is most likely to ask a question in lecture that clears the room?
Who's the one most likely to change degrees three times?
Who would be most likely to accidentally walk into the wrong lecture and stay for the whole hour?
Who would cry first at a graduation ceremony?
Who is most likely to print an assignment at 8:55 for a 9am deadline?
Who has the worst taste in student share house furniture?
Who would be most likely to join every society at Orientation Week for the free stuff?
Who would borrow a textbook and return it two years later?
Who among us is most likely to nap in the library and drool on the notes?
Who would be most likely to write a thesis about something nobody has ever heard of?
Who do you reckon is most likely to bring snacks to a quiet study session and crunch loudly?
Who's the one most likely to make a flowchart to organise a night out?
Who would be most likely to become a professor and never leave campus?
Who is most likely to say "I'll just study for one hour" and end up at the bar?
Who would be most likely to wear pyjamas to a morning tutorial?
Who would forget the whole semester's worth of notes on a bus?
Who among us is most likely to gatecrash a lecture just because the topic sounded fun?
Who would be most likely to run for student council and win by a landslide?
Who do you reckon is most likely to get lost on their very first day for the whole day?
Who's the one most likely to rent the cheapest room with a mysterious damp smell?
Who would be most likely to ask for an extension for a reason that gets more dramatic every time?
Who is most likely to finish a degree and then immediately start another?
Who would be most likely to survive a week of exams on coffee and spite?
Who would sell their old notes for beer money?
Who among us is most likely to ghost the group project chat until the last day?
Who would be most likely to turn up to the uni ball in a costume that was meant for another event?
Who do you reckon is most likely to hand in an essay with a typo in the title?
Who's the one most likely to run the whole campus cafe tab up to a ridiculous total?
Who would be most likely to skip a class and be the one spotted by the lecturer?
Who is most likely to organise a study group that turns into a party?
Who would be most likely to say "I never study" and then be top of the class?
Who would snag a front-row parking spot on campus using only charm?
Who among us is most likely to call a pub crawl "research"?
Who would be most likely to submit the wrong file and not notice for a week?
Who do you reckon is most likely to win a debate by talking louder than everyone?
Who's the one most likely to hook up with someone from the same lecture and then avoid them for a year?
Who would be most likely to have a crush on a tutor and deny it?
Who is most likely to sneak someone into the dorms and get caught by security?
Who would be most likely to end up at a toga party and lose the toga?
